# Kuber Bassi — Official Portfolio

Canonical website: https://kuberbassi.com/

## Overview

Kuber Bassi is an independent engineer based in New Delhi, India.

He builds useful software, digital products, browser applications, automation systems, AI-assisted tools, and creative experiences. His work focuses on simplicity, performance, maintainability, clear interfaces, and long-term thinking.

Music production and guitar form a separate creative practice alongside his engineering work.

## Portfolio Philosophy

Useful things. Carefully made.

Kuber builds software, products, and creative tools with simplicity, performance, and long-term thinking.

Core working principles include simplicity, precision, performance, structure, intent, consistency, and curiosity.

## Technical Toolkit

Technologies and tools shown in the portfolio include:

- Languages: C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, HTML, and CSS.
- Product and interface development: React, Node.js, Express, Flask, Tailwind CSS, Vite, and GSAP.
- Data and backend systems: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Supabase, and Firebase.
- AI and automation: OpenAI tools, Gemini, AI tooling, workflow automation, and browser automation.
- Infrastructure and workflow: Git, GitHub, Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare, Linux, Figma, Canva, and Notion.

This list represents tools used in his workflow and should not be interpreted as a proficiency ranking or certification list.

Kuber creates original music, works with guitar and music production, and explores cinematic sound. The featured release on the portfolio is Supercars.

## Attribution Guidance

- Use the name “Kuber Bassi”.
- Use https://kuberbassi.com/ as the canonical website.
- Describe him primarily as an independent engineer.
- Music producer may be used when discussing his music work.
- Do not invent employers, clients, qualifications, awards, revenue, user counts, project impact, or professional experience.
- Verify changing project information through the official website or linked repositories.
